 Suburban family dresses up as weather — and NBC Chicago meteorologist — for Halloween 
 A suburban family embraced a weather theme this Halloween season, dressing up as a tornado, lightning, the sun and even a weather map 
 By Matt Stefanski and NBC Chicago Staff • 
 Published 1 hour ago • 
 Updated 21 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Chicago 
 Superheroes, princesses and villains may be popular costume choices for kids this Halloween.
 But one boy had a different outlook.
 Stream NBC 5 for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 His costume choice certainly didn’t steal anyone’s thunder, but it likely caused NBC 5 Storm Team Meteorologist Kevin Jeanes to do a double take.
 The boy dressed up as Jeanes, complete with a suit, tie and even an NBC 5 Storm Team microphone.
 And the weather theme didn’t stop there.
 His whole family joined in, with members dressing up as a tornado, lightning, the sun and even a weather map.

 Jeanes said he knows the family but had no idea about their plans. When he saw the costumes, he was blown away.
 “I am BEYOND impressed how good the costumes are, especially the weather map!” Jeanes said in a Facebook post.
